uutiset.s: Botswana will take a 5% stake in mines developed on prospecting concessions held by its newly formed exploration company.

uutiset.s: Malaysia's Employees Provident Fund CEO Ahmad Zulqarnain Onn says the EPF favors infrastructure in 2027. It's one of the world's oldest and largest pension funds, with total investment assets of over $350 billion. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: AUD/USD: Aussie Set for Biggest Monthly Drop in Four Years as Stocks Fall
uutiset.s: The Australian dollar is poised for its biggest monthly slide in more than 13 years as it extended losses on Wednesday, with the weakness in global stocks damping demand for currencies linked to growth.

uutiset.t: A 2018 Playbook Would Not Bode Well for Markets: Taking Stock
uutiset.s: Signs suggest the market is moving past peak fear, but investors need a fresh source of conviction before returning in force — especially as the current setup revives memories of 2018’s punishing selloff in risk assets.

uutiset.t: EasyJet Profit Hit By Iran War as Apollo Takeover Looms
uutiset.s: EasyJet Plc said the fallout from Middle East war eroded most of its profit in the fiscal year, with soaring fuel prices hitting the budget carrier as it prepares to be taken over by a US private equity firm early next year.

uutiset.t: Neuberg Diagnostics Is Said to Pick Banks for $200 Million IPO
uutiset.s: Neuberg Diagnostics Pvt. has picked banks for an initial public offering that could raise as much as $200 million, according to people familiar with the matter, adding to a busy pipeline of Indian deals.

uutiset.t: Restructuring Firm Interpath in Deal to Buy US Company, CEO Says
uutiset.s: Interpath Ltd. is pushing to expand in the US on the heels of being taken over by private equity firm Bridgepoint Group Plc, according to its chief executive officer, who dismissed concerns that a string of senior departures was hurting the restructuring firm.
